name: Splidebox
project_description:
Splide within lightbox.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 
 Blazy 
 Splide 
 
 Back to top 

 Best with 
 
 Lightbox image style option with Scale (has width and empty height), not cropped. Or original if already optimized before upload. 
 Thumbnail style with Crop at blazy-related formatters so to have thumbnail navigation properly. 
 
 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Since 2.0.3, thumbnail navigation, removable at Blazy UI under Splidebox. Be sure to fill out Thumbnail style option at blazy-related formatters when choosing Splidebox under Media switcher option. 
 Since 2.0.3 + Blazy:2.23, works with Views Blazy Grid, Table, List, Splide, etc., read more . 
 Supports zoomable (Responsive|Picture) image, (local|remote) video, AJAX loaded contents. 
 Fullscreen window. 
 Wheel zoom. 
 Works with product variations w/o ElevateZoom Plus .
